'''Second Anthology''' is the 21st expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 15 March 2000. The set consists of 6 new promo cards.

Each buff, sturdy, 800 card '''Second Anthology''' box contains 6 new black bordered promo cards (not included in any previous or future expansions), 2 [[Starter Deck II]] reprint boxes (with the 2000 copyright line rather then 1998) plus 2 boosters each from [[First Contact]], [[Deep Space Nine]] and [[The Dominion]]. Also included is an insert list of items found in the box and a complete card list booklet (from '''Premiere''' to '''Second Anthology''').

==Type Breakdown==
*6 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (1 Bajoran, 1 Cardassian, 1 Dominion, 2 Federation, 1 Klingon and 1 Romulan)

'''NOTE:''' There is 1 Dual Affiliations card, thus the total is higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
*6 [[:Category:Promo (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Promo]]
